description: This Java class defines an Android activity named ContactsListActivity that extends ListActivity. It demonstrates creating a UI with a ListView populated via an adapter loaded from an XML resource, displaying a list of contacts with additional features such as starred status and photos.

classes.name: ContactsListActivity
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that loads a list adapter from an XML resource and sets it to display contacts with associated data such as photos and starred status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and loads the list adapter from an XML resource.
